_description: Test cases for validating cost analysis quality. Each case specifies legislation and expected analysis outcomes.
_why: Known-cost legislation provides ground truth for validating the analysis pipeline produces reasonable results.

test_cases.name: Proclamation (ceremonial, no costs)
test_cases.description: Proclamations are purely declarative and should have no compliance costs

test_cases.name: Proclamation under the Police Offences Act
test_cases.description: Another proclamation - should have no compliance costs

test_cases.name: Defence Legislation Amendment (Woomera)
test_cases.description: Creates permit requirements for accessing prohibited areas - should have compliance costs for businesses and citizens

test_cases.name: Local Government Order 2004
test_cases.description: Administrative order for land transfers - minimal compliance costs, some enforcement

test_cases.name: Employment Agents Registration Act 1993
test_cases.description: Requires business registration - should have compliance costs for businesses

test_cases.name: Human Reproductive Technology Licences and Registers Regulations
test_cases.description: Licensing and registration requirements for healthcare facilities
